meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码库交给多名漏洞猎手和验证工程师并行审查,找出真正可利用的缺陷并定级。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布前想确认代码里没有被忽视的可利用漏洞。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to confirm exploitable flaws before shipping.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 Team Mode 组建 5 人小队（3 名漏洞猎手 + 2 名 PoC 工程师），并行审计代码库，用最小 PoC 验证漏洞是否真能利用并按可利用性定级，最后产出带 PASS/BLOCK 结论、发现表和复现步骤的报告。
howto.when: 当你要求安全审查、漏洞审计、可利用性审计等，或输入 /security-research 时接管；前提是 team 工具可用、在主会话运行、且有具体审计目标（仓库、diff、PR 等）。

say.text: 对这个仓库做一次安全审查
say.note: 会按当前分支与上游的 diff 审计

say.text: 审计这个 PR 的可利用性，只报能复现的问题
say.note: 无攻击路径的候选会被降级或剔除

say.text: 用 /security-research 检查这个发布候选版本

howto.what_en: Claude runs a 5-member Team Mode squad (3 vulnerability hunters + 2 PoC engineers) that audits a codebase in parallel, proves exploitability with minimal PoCs, and reports a PASS/BLOCK verdict, findings table, and repro steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers on security review, vulnerability or exploitability audit, or `/security-research`; needs team tools, main session, and a concrete target (repo, diff, PR, release candidate, or path list).

say_en.text: Run a security review of this repository
say_en.note: Audits current branch diff vs upstream

say_en.text: Audit this PR's exploitability and report only reproducible issues
say_en.note: Candidates without an attack path get downgraded

say_en.text: Use /security-research to check this release candidate
